import { rwGet, rwPatch, rwPost, rwPut } from "/src/features/research-workspace/api/client.ts";
export async function listProjects() {
  const r = await rwGet("/projects");
  return r?.items ?? [];
}
export async function createProject(input) {
  const r = await rwPost("/projects", input);
  return r.project;
}
export async function getProject(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}`);
  return r.project;
}
export async function patchProject(projectId, body) {
  const r = await rwPatch(`/projects/${projectId}`, body);
  return r.project;
}
export async function getOverview(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`
  );
  return r?.overview ?? r;
}
export async function getRecent(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/recent`);
  return r?.recent ?? null;
}
export async function putRecent(projectId, recent) {
  const r = await rwPut(`/projects/${projectId}/recent`, recent);
  return r.recent;
}
export async function getHistory(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/history`);
  return r?.items ?? [];
}
